name: Computer
description: Gives an agent its own persistent Linux desktop with a real browser. The agent sees and drives it (screen, accessibility tree, mouse, keyboard); you can watch live and take over to log into any website, and the session stays logged in across restarts.
tagline: Your agent's own Linux computer with a browser you can log into

changelog.notes: Initial release — a persistent desktop and browser per agent, live view with take-over, and computer-use tools
